Eileen: quick sync note  we've had a couple of near-miss incidents where compaction + nondeterministic attribution made postmortems hard. proposing a tiny, ops-first playbook for deterministic attribution + shedding heuristics.
Samir: definitely. what are the non-negotiables?
Eileen: minimal list: (1) a tiny admin policy API for rolling token budgets, (2) runtime predicate engine for mode selection, (3) SDK advisory surface (advisory only), (4) compact_audit event shape that billing can consume, (5) rehydrate protocol for late enrichment.
Vik: strongly +1 on deterministic cohort ids. propose cohort_id = sha256(tenant|route|policy_id|minute_bucket) so joins are repeatable.
Jo: shed modes we should support: KEEP_FULL, TRIM_ATTRS, SKELETON, TOMBSTONE. every non-KEEP_FULL action must emit a compact_audit.
Eileen: example compact_audit (single-line json in the log stream) as a string in the playbook: "{\"cohort_id\":\"sha256:...\",\"tenant\":\"acct-42\",\"route\":\"/v1/generate\",\"mode\":\"SKELETON\",\"tokens_saved\":3280,\"policy_id\":\"telemetry_v4\",\"orig_ids_present\":false}"
Samir: SDK advisory API idea: telemetry.advisory({level:'ok'|'warn'|'shed',actions:['trim_attrs'|'drop_spans'],ttl_s:45}) - advisory only; server decides final fate. keep SDK impl best-effort.
Vik: runtime predicate examples should be tiny boolean rules operators can push: e.g. "when cpu_pct>80 and queue_ms>200 then mode=SKELETON for priority>=200". avoid complex DSLs.
Jo: rehydration flow: when enrichment arrives after compaction, emit a rehydrate_delta referencing cohort_id and any resolved orig_ids; include tokens_consumed and attribution_map. billing reconciles compaction_reserve if orig_ids were missing.
Eileen: incident runbook (short): T0: bump soft threshold via admin API; T1: toggle SKELETON for non-critical routes; T2: enable TOMBSTONE for experimental prefixes and notify customers; Post: 72h cohort reconciliation and cost delta report.
Samir: metrics to add: telemetry.compaction.count, telemetry.compaction.tokens_saved_total, telemetry.rehydrate.count, telemetry.shed.count and per-tenant compaction_rate.
Vik: action items: Samir will mock the admin API and tiny predicate engine, Jo will draft the compact_audit + rehydrate schema examples, Eileen will write the 1-page ops playbook and schedule a quick gate.
ops-bot: deploy note: telemetry-ingest v3.11 canary started :rocket:
Eileen: thanks all 44d will post the draft in #eng-docs by EOD.
